title: ELS Detector Golden Set
description: Per-state golden set used by evaluation/eval_suite.py to grade the detector. Each file is a hand-annotated picture of what the detector SHOULD produce for one source document.

notes.description: Free-form context for annotators / future readers.

expected_depth_map.description: What infer_depth_map SHOULD return for this document. Used to grade Pass-1.

elements.description: Hand-annotated structural elements. Use as many as needed to cover the document; even a few-dozen-per-state is enough to detect regressions.

test_case_id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. CA-IND-01-EARLY. Used so failure messages reference a specific row.

code.description: The DOCUMENT-LOCAL code the detector emits (e.g. domain 'ATL', strand '1.0', indicator '1.1'). NOT the full dotted parser code. Detector matching is code-agnostic (title + age_band + domain), so this is informational; null is fine where the document has no code.

age_band.description: Required for indicators that come from age-band columns; null otherwise.

parser_expected.description: Authoritative expected PARSER output for this element (only meaningful on indicators). The detector never produces these; parentage, full hierarchical codes, month-normalized age bands, and standard_id assembly are parser.py's job. Populated from a human-verified parser run (see evaluation/_bootstrap_parser_expected.py) and graded for exact equality by eval_parser.py. The detector grader ignores this block.

age_band_months.description: Parser's month-normalized age band, e.g. '36-54' (Early), '36-66' (Later), '36-48' (PK3), '48-60' (PK4). Null when the indicator carries no age band.

regression_cases.description: Behavioural assertions targeted at known failure modes. Each case is checked against live pipeline output and reported pass/fail: eval_detector.py runs cases via regression_checks.lookup (check_<id>), eval_parser.py via regression_checks.lookup_parser (check_parser_<id>); a case with no function for a stage is SKIPped. Keep them assertion-style.

description.description: Human-readable reason for this case (links to a real bug if applicable).

assertion.description: Plain-English assertion. The matching check function lives in evaluation/regression_checks.py keyed by id.
